description: This PHP source file defines the Goteo\Library\Newsletter class, which provides static methods for generating SQL queries related to newsletter testers, receivers, and donors, as well as methods for retrieving newsletter content in different languages. It interacts with models for users, projects, and investments, and includes methods for fetching and rendering newsletter content with dynamic project and post data.

classes.name: Newsletter
classes.description: Provides static methods for generating newsletter-related SQL queries, fetching newsletter content, and rendering newsletter HTML with dynamic project and post data.

methods.name: getTestersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query string to retrieve newsletter testers filtered by languages.

methods.name: getTesters
methods.description: Fetches a list of newsletter testers or their count from the database.

methods.name: getReceiversSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query string to retrieve active newsletter receivers who haven't blocked mailing, filtered by languages.

methods.name: getReceivers
methods.description: Fetches a list of newsletter receivers or their count from the database.

methods.name: getDonorsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query string to retrieve donors filtered by languages and fiscal year.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Fetches a list of donors or their count, considering the current fiscal year.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Generates newsletter HTML content, including dynamic project and post sections, in specified language.
